test_title: PYST 172: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 16th Nov,, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Mohan told to / Sagar that he / was looking / very pale.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Mohan told to**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **use of preposition "to" after the verb 'told' is incorrect**.
